errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there are data points at x-values of 140 and 160 as part of a list. While there is a point at 140, there is no data point at 160; the last data point is at approximately 155.
The description states that the 'Accuracy' line continues to 160 on the x-axis. The data series actually ends at an x-value of approximately 155.
The description states that the 'Confidence' line continues to 160 on the x-axis. The data series actually ends at an x-value of approximately 155.
The description states that the 'Alignment' line ends at an x-value of 160. The data series actually ends at an x-value of approximately 155.

The description combines 'QA performance' (from the paper caption) and 'accuracy' (from the legend) into 'QA performance/accuracy', which is slightly awkward and not directly present on the chart itself. The legend simply says 'Accuracy'.
The description states the value for 'Confidence' at 'Question Popularity' 20 is 0.91, but the data point is located exactly on the grid line for 0.90.
The description gives the value for 'Confidence' at 'Question Popularity' 50-60 as 0.96, but the data points are visibly higher, at approximately 0.97.
